topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The rain's been coming down like it's never gonna stop, just like my mood when I sloshed up to this little suburban lie. Homeowner's all worked up 'bout some junk the last bums left behind in the attic. Like I've got time to sift through memories no one wants. But he's deep in his story, thinks the papers, the toys, the forgotten coats hold all the secrets of the universe or somethin'. I'm supposed to tell what's what, what's here and gone, who's a keeper and who's just dead weight. Played this tune before, every city, different faces. Ain't nothin' new under the dripping eaves. Dig into the past all you want, in the end, it's just you and the rain.
